actions.description: WF-EM-5 — the verb allowlist for THIS gate. Forwarded into the suspend payload, so it becomes `interrupt.data.actions`: `validateResumeValue` refuses any other verb with a 400 (the run stays interrupted rather than recording a decision the approver did not make) and both approval cards render only these buttons. Omit to keep the full default set (approve | reject | request-changes | defer | escalate). Declare it whenever the gate's `falsy approved` branch leads to a TERMINAL node, or `defer`/`escalate` — which have no member in the decision union — fall through to `refine` and are written down as a decline.

approverRefs.description: WF-UP-2 — subjects who may decide this gate (the ACL the host enforces, ADR 0677). Blank entries are dropped, so an empty list or "" keeps an OPEN gate (any member).

approverGroupRefs.description: Groups whose members may decide this gate.

approverRoleRefs.description: Roles whose holders may decide this gate.

overrideScopes.description: Scopes that may override a quorum gate (only consulted when requiredApprovals > 1).

requiredApprovals.description: WF-UP-2 — N-of-M quorum: how many distinct eligible approvers must accept before the gate passes (the host's openwop-interrupt-quorum resolver). 1 (or absent) is a single-approver gate.

rejectionPolicy.description: With requiredApprovals > 1: 'any' (default) — one reject vetoes; 'majority' — more than half must reject.
